layout.body:
BRUCKVILLE
(May 16)
Downtown Books, a family-owned bookstore operating for 15 years, recently added a café area and expanded its evening hours to accommodate working customers.
Owner Janet Miller explains, “We noticed many people wanted to browse books after work but couldn’t make it during our traditional hours.”
The store now stays open until 9 P.M. on weekdays and offers coffee, pastries, and light meals alongside its selection of books, magazines, and gifts. The café area includes comfortable seating and free Wi-Fi for customers who want to read or work.

questions.analysis: Why does the bookstore close at 9 p.m. on weekdays? Bài gốc căn cứ: many people wanted to browse books after work but couldn’t make it during our traditional hours. rất nhiều người suy nghĩ một chút lớp sau đọc sách, nhưng ở nguyên lai buôn bán thời gian không đuổi kịp. (A) và địa phương sách khác điếm cạnh tranh → Sai (B) là tại buôn bán bình thường trên thời gian ban khách hàng phục vụ → Đúng (C) làm người đám cung cấp sử dụng miễn phí Wi‑Fi nơi → Sai (D) đề cao cà phê và bánh ngọt lượng tiêu thụ → Sai
